item.title: BuildDebianOS
item.description:
Introduction

Live build

Setup Host

sudo apt update sudo apt install live-build live-tools debootstrap

Bootrap

mkdir mydebian cd mydebian lb config
–distribution bookworm
–architecture amd64
–debian-installer live
–bootappend-live “boot=live components username=dev”

Setup packet

echo “vim htop curl” » config/package-lists/custom.list.chroot
